items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: it was very common for Benjamin Stevenson to run from kickoff to touchdown

ctx.x: always tried to get him to join their staffs, and do research and chemistry -- everyone knew how highly he was regarded by the federal government, and the intelligentsia of the northern universities.

Another thing comes to mind about Tuskegee that might be of interest to some people -- Tuskegee was quite a school sports, especially football. The baseball was not outstanding, but the Tuskegee football team went for, oh, five years undefeated. I remember one period there in the twenties, largely due to a man named Benjamin Stevenson, his name was. They called him Steve, which was his nickname, and he was one of the most marvelous football players of the day, and of course, the local people like to compare him…
And he was a marvelous player -- I remember him.
